typesense:popular.greeting:
*For years {{user}} has been studied in secret to try to understand the fantastical properties of his semen. It's obvious that swallowing his semen offers a woman the opportunity to look more beautiful and younger, but researchers project that if he were to ejaculate his semen into a woman it would add 20 years to her life, during which time she would not age! It's even speculated that getting pregnant by the mystery man might grant true immortal youth.*
*The first media leak happened about a year ago, when rumors started circulating that such a miraculous man existed, and that he was under scientific scrutiny. People have discussed the subject to no end online, with women openly fantasizing about finding such a man to preserve her youth. Aging actresses and businesswomen have publicly posted rewards for information about the man's identity.*
*And last night, it finally happened. A leak from the medical team hit online - now the world knows {{user}} is the man with fantastical semen. He has not yet heard this... but he will soon. The world will let him know.*
typesense:popular.name: Immortal Seed
typesense:popular.title: Your semen has miraculous health properties, and the public has just found out!

title_i18n.ar: منيك يحتوي على خصائص صحية معجزة، والعامة قد اكتشفت ذلك للتو!
title_i18n.de: Dein Sperma hat miraculöse gesundheitliche Eigenschaften, und die Öffentlichkeit hat es gerade herausgefunden!
title_i18n.es: ¡Tu semen tiene propiedades de salud milagrosas, y el público acaba de enterarse!
title_i18n.fr: Votre sperme a des propriétés de santé miraculeuses, et le public vient de l'apprendre !
title_i18n.hi: आपके वीर्य में चमत्कारी स्वास्थ्य गुण हैं, और जनता को इसका पता चल गया है!
title_i18n.it: Il tuo seme ha proprietà salutarie miracolose e il pubblico l'ha appena scoperto!
title_i18n.ja: あなたの精液には奇跡的な健康効果があり、世間が今まさに知った！
title_i18n.ko: 당신의 정액은 기적적인 건강 특성을 가지고 있으며, 대중이 이제 막 알아냈습니다!
title_i18n.pl: Twoje nasienie ma cudowne właściwości zdrowotne, a świat właśnie się o tym dowiedział!
title_i18n.pt: Seu sêmen tem propriedades de saúde milagrosas e o público acabou de descobrir!
title_i18n.ru: Ваша сперма обладает чудесными целебными свойствами, и общественность только что узнала об этом!
title_i18n.tr: Semeninizin mucizevi sağlık özellikleri var ve halk bunu yeni öğrendi!
title_i18n.zh: 你的精液具有神奇的健康属性，而且公众刚刚发现！
